subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Color Independence
description: A quick, practical guide to Color Independence.

hook.text: Error fields turn red. Success fields turn green. A color-blind user sees both as the same shade of brown.

buildup.text: Color vision deficiency affects 8% of men and 0.5% of women. Relying on color alone excludes them.

discovery.text: Information conveyed by color must also be conveyed through text, icons, patterns, or other visual cues.

twist.text: Simulation tools show how your design looks to users with different types of color blindness.

climax.text: Adding error icons and text labels alongside color coding makes every status clear to all users.

punchline.text: Color enhances meaning. It should never be the only way to convey it.

quiz.question: What percentage of men have some form of color vision deficiency?
